description.en: Stresemann's Bristlefront is one of the world's rarest and most critically endangered birds, with perhaps only a single individual known to exist in the wild. A member of the tapaculo family, it is a medium-sized, long-tailed bird characterized by the distinctive stiff bristles on its forehead. The species was first described in the 1830s but went unseen for over 50 years until its rediscovery in 1995. It is endemic to a tiny fragment of the Atlantic Forest in eastern Brazil. Its survival is precariously balanced on the preservation of the Mata do Passarinho Reserve, as its habitat has been decimated by logging, charcoal production, and agricultural expansion.
description.zh: 斯特雷泽曼须额穴鸟是世界上最稀有且处于极度濒危状态的鸟类之一，目前野外可能仅存一个个体。作为窜鸟科的一员，它是一种中等体型、长尾的鸟类，最显著的特征是额头上长有独特的坚硬鬃毛。该物种最初于19世纪30年代被描述，但在消失了50多年后才于1995年被重新发现。它是巴西东部大西洋森林极小碎片地带的特有种。由于伐木、木炭生产和农业扩张导致其栖息地遭到毁灭性破坏，该物种的生存完全依赖于“小鸟森林保护区”（Mata do Passarinho Reserve）的保护。

anatomy.en: The Stresemann's Bristlefront measures approximately 20 cm in length. It exhibits sexual dimorphism: the male is predominantly slaty-grey with a dark chestnut-brown vent and rump, while the female is more cinnamon-brown or rufous on the underparts. Its most striking anatomical feature is the cluster of long, stiff, forward-pointing bristles at the base of the bill, the function of which is not fully understood but may assist in sensory perception or protection while foraging in dense leaf litter. It has strong legs adapted for a terrestrial lifestyle and a notably long, slender tail.
anatomy.zh: 斯特雷泽曼须额穴鸟体长约20厘米。该物种表现出雌雄异形：雄鸟主要呈石板灰色，臀部和尾下覆羽为深栗褐色；雌鸟下体则更多呈现肉桂色或红褐色。其最引人注目的解剖特征是喙基部长有一簇长而坚硬、向前伸出的鬃毛，其功能尚不完全清楚，但可能在茂密的落叶层中觅食时起到感官感知或保护作用。它拥有强壮的双腿，适应地面生活，并有一条显著细长的尾巴。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This species is extremely secretive and primarily terrestrial, spending most of its time on the forest floor. It feeds on insects and other small invertebrates found by rummaging through leaf litter. Its song is a distinctive, descending series of musical notes, which is often the only way researchers can locate the bird in the dense undergrowth. Breeding behavior is poorly documented due to its rarity, but like other tapaculos, it is believed to nest in burrows or cavities close to the ground. The bird is highly sensitive to micro-climate changes and requires undisturbed primary forest with a thick leaf litter layer.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 该物种行为极其隐秘，主要在地面活动，大部分时间都在森林底层度过。它通过在落叶层中翻找来捕食昆虫和其他小型无脊椎动物。它的鸣声是一系列独特的、下降音阶的悦耳音符，这通常是研究人员在茂密的灌木丛中定位该鸟的唯一方法。由于极其罕见，其繁殖行为记录甚少，但据信与其他窜鸟类似，它在靠近地面的洞穴或孔隙中筑巢。这种鸟对微气候变化高度敏感，需要拥有厚实落叶层的未受干扰的原始森林。

habitat_and_distribution.en: The distribution of Stresemann's Bristlefront is restricted to an incredibly small area in the Atlantic Forest of eastern Brazil, specifically on the border of the states of Minas Gerais and Bahia. Its entire known range is confined to the Mata do Passarinho (Songbird Forest) Reserve and immediately adjacent fragments. This habitat consists of humid montane forest at elevations between 600 and 900 meters. The region is characterized by high biodiversity but is under constant threat from fires and habitat fragmentation, making this bird one of the most range-restricted avian species on Earth.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 斯特雷泽曼须额穴鸟的分布范围仅限于巴西东部大西洋森林中一个极小的区域，具体位于米纳斯吉拉斯州和巴伊亚州的交界处。其所有已知活动范围都局限在“小鸟森林保护区”及其紧邻的碎片地带。该栖息地由海拔600至900米之间的潮湿山地森林组成。该地区以高生物多样性为特征，但持续受到火灾和栖息地破碎化的威胁，使这种鸟成为地球上分布范围最狭窄的鸟类之一。

habitat.text_en: Humid Atlantic Forest fragments in Minas Gerais and Bahia, Brazil.
habitat.text_zh: 巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州和巴伊亚州的潮湿大西洋森林碎片地带。
